tasks.label: commit-cors-fix
tasks.command: git add -- client/src/main.tsx client/src/lib/queryClient.ts .github/workflows/deploy.yml; git commit -m "Fix SWA-App Service CORS path and branch-aware SWA rewrites"

tasks.label: copilot-git-precheck
tasks.command: git status --short; git branch --show-current; git remote -v

tasks.label: copilot-gh-check
tasks.command: gh --version; gh auth status; gh workflow list

tasks.label: copilot-commit-push-cors-fix
tasks.command: git add .github/workflows/deploy.yml client/src/lib/queryClient.ts client/src/main.tsx; git commit -m "Fix SWA-to-AppService CORS by using same-origin API routes on SWA"; git push origin develop

tasks.label: copilot-commit-push-cors-fix-2
tasks.command: git add .github/workflows/deploy.yml client/src/lib/queryClient.ts client/src/main.tsx; git commit -m 'Fix SWA AppService CORS by using same origin API routes on SWA'; git push origin develop; git log -1 --oneline

tasks.label: copilot-trigger-workflow
tasks.command: gh workflow run "CareOrbit Deploy Pipeline" --ref develop; gh run list --workflow "CareOrbit Deploy Pipeline" --limit 3

tasks.label: copilot-trigger-workflow-2
tasks.command: gh workflow run .github/workflows/deploy.yml --ref develop; gh run list -w .github/workflows/deploy.yml --limit 5

tasks.label: copilot-verify-head-and-trigger
